name: SVC_CATEGORIES_INT
description: This table is used to store the list of categories that the SR belongs to. Categories can be hierarchical.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: For each run of the job, import wizard generates a new batch id and this batch id will be used uniquely .

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by import wizard to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This is an optional column and would be useful if consumers want any error message as the first error.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates import wizard if the import to base table was successful or Erorred out.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: This column is necessary for the bulk import operation.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Used to link this record with the error record.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PARENT_CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_CATEGORIES_B(CATEGORY_ID). Defines category hierarchy by storing the parent category ID, or null if this is a root category.

columns.name: CATEGORY_NAME
columns.description: Specifies the name of the category.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the category is enabled (Y or N)

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action code will be used to determine what operation should be done: insert,update,delete.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Internal action code will be populated internally by framework based on ourcome of match step.

columns.name: INTERNAL_OVN
columns.description: The Object Version Number of the record begin updated. Used for Optimistic Locking as part of Incremental Update.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference if record was imported.

columns.name: PARENT_CATEGORY_OSR
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference of parent category if record was imported.

columns.name: CATEGORY_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: To provide short name for the category.

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the stripe code, such as CRM or HCM.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the category is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: CSS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the category is visible in CSS portal (Y or N).

columns.name: BU_ORG_ID
columns.description: Stores the Business Unit Org Id of the category.
